designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Noxubee National Wildlife Refuge by Executive Order 8444 on June 14, 1940, on lands bought under 1930s resettlement programs.

review.note: Year confirmed; exact date and EO added. Renamed Sam D. Hamilton Noxubee NWR later.
